objections: NVIDIA: Statutory/default bail arises from CrPC/BNSS Section 167 (procedure), not POCSO Act specifically.

Alibaba: The definition is incomplete/misleading. Statutory bail (under Section 439 CrPC) is a right available to the accused after a certain period of detention, not merely 'bail determined by the court' in POCSO. POCSO has specific provisions for bail, but the term 'statutory bail' has a specific procedural meaning.

Google: The Hindi definition/context links it specifically to POCSO, whereas statutory bail (default bail) is governed by Section 187 of the BNSS (formerly Sec 167 CrPC) applicable generally, not unique to POCSO.
